نحتف (form VIII)
# نَحْتَفِ (naḥtafi) /naħ.ta.fi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# نُحْتَفَ (nuḥtafa) /nuħ.ta.fa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
